incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: pghigh - inference-gateway-usw2 — 1m 5xx error-rate > 8%. Auto-pager to #incidents. PD: https://pagerduty.example/PD12345
katy: acked and oncall — looking now. any customer-facing routes impacted?
rishi: seeing 502/504 predominantly on /v1/generate endpoints, spike started ~10:21 UTC, error rate ~12% for last 2 mins. logs show backend upstream 503s from model-worker pool.
miguel: on it, checking GPU pool health and k8s pod restart counts.
emma: any customer-reported incidents? support queue shows a few tickets for slow/fails from orgs on dedicated capacity.
katy: good to know. tagging infra-runbook — Nikhil, can you paste the quick mitigation steps?
nikhil: runbook snippet — start with scaling and fallback:```bash
# scale inference pool
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/model-worker --replicas=20
# divert traffic to canary pool
curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/routes/divert -d '{"from":"usw2-primary","to":"usw2-canary"}'
```
nikhil: also set circuit-breaker on gateway to reduce retries: `gatewayctl set-cb --endpoint "/v1/generate" --threshold 5`
katy: doing the scale now. miguel, can you check if KV cache eviction happened? rishi, any recent deploys?
miguel: cache lookups spiked and eviction happened at 10:20; warming cold caches now. redis metrics show 95% hit drop.
rishi: no prod deploy in last 6 hours. rolling restarts of model-worker pods started automatically (OOMs). suspect memory regression in latest quantized runtime — reverting recommended.
at 10:23 pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: pghigh acknowledged by katy (oncall). Escalation paused.
katy: reverting quantized runtime on us-west2 model-worker to previous image: `kubectl -n inference set image deploy/model-worker model-worker=myregistry/model-worker:v1.3.2` — starting canary rollback.
miguel: confirmed new replicas coming up with v1.3.2, old pods terminating. KV cache warmers running.
emma: notifying support to send a short status to affected customers, include ETA 15-20 mins.
nikhil: suggestion: temporarily increase request timeout and reduce client retries to cut downstream load: `gatewayctl set-timeout --all 6s` and `gatewayctl set-retries --all 1`
katy: applied timeout/retries. observing immediate drop in retry-related 502s. error-rate down to 6% (1m).
rishi: monitoring logs for root-cause traces, but early signal looks like memory leak in runtime affecting KV retention -> OOM -> pod restarts -> cache churn -> upstream 5xx.
miguel: infra will keep pool at higher replica count for 20 mins to let cache stabilize.
emma: customer comms queued for 10:35 UTC. drafting message now.
katy: okay keep PD updated. if error-rate stays <5% for 5m we can close.
merchantnote: (reaction) :thumbsup:  — small ephemeral note, not a message.
katy: last check 10:33 UTC — 1m error-rate 3.8%, retries reduced. continuing to monitor.
katy: closing PD incident in 15m if stable; handing off to morning oncall if persists. anyone else?
rishi: will follow up with an RCA ticket and rollout block on the quantized runtime until patch.
emma: thanks team — good run.
incident-bot: Incident thread closed (auto) after 30m inactivity — PD incident resolved.
